name: Facet
text: Implement a dark theme by default with a light-theme toggle that’s always visible in the top-right corner. This maximizes visibility and liveliness in low-light conditions while giving users control—critical for long sessions. The trade-off is slightly higher battery drain on mobile, but the clarity and enjoyment gains outweigh it.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The toggle’s real risk is habituation—users won’t switch even when glare or battery drain matters. A better alternative is a context-aware theme that auto-switches based on ambient light or battery level, with manual override. Settle it by testing both: measure how often users override the default and the impact on battery life in real-world use.
